# S09 · Inventory & ERP sync

[All stages](README.md) · [Wave 1](README.md#wave-1) · [README dashboard](../../README.md#all-28-stages) · [Register section](../MASTER-REGISTER.md#s09--inventory--erp-sync--pr-194207)

> **বাংলায় — স্টক আর ERP সংযোগ:**
> - স্টকের আসল হিসাব থাকে আপনার ERP-তে; দোকান সেখান থেকে SKU আর সাইজ ধরে স্টক আনে।
> - একই শেষ পিস দুজনের কাছে বিক্রি হয় না; অর্ডার ERP-তে ডকুমেন্ট হিসেবে যায়, একবারই।
> - ERP-এর চাবি না দেওয়া পর্যন্ত একটা প্র্যাকটিস ERP চলে, আসল স্টকে হাত দেয় না।

## PR 195

**Stock pull from the ERP at SKU / colour / size level**

**বাংলায়:** SKU, রং আর সাইজ ধরে ERP থেকে স্টক আনা; একই বদল দুবার গোনা হয় না।

**Details**

- **Status:** Merged · 2026-10-20
  - Build status row: stock pull per SKU / colour / size into StockLevel (variant × location): incremental with `updatedSince` minus an overlap, paged, resumable after a failure or the page cap; older rows never overwrite newer; one StockMovement per change with an idempotency key from the ERP's state (re-reading never moves stock twice); unknown / retired SKUs and unlinked warehouses counted, never guessed; `inStock` and the product summary follow; checkout check (`liveStock`, one quick try, else the copy); job functions for the BullMQ worker (`inventory.erp.pullStock`, poll every `erp.sync.stockPollMinutes`); `GET /api/admin/inventory/stock` (one SKU in every location, or a product's colour × size grid). 23 Oct (follow-up 16, CN-017 SIM-F-006, with PR 197 and 203): the shared balance is never clipped (−1 shows as −1 on the stock answer, the grid and the low-stock alert); every open order waiting to be packed with a short SKU gets one shortage card (PackingIssue kind SHORTAGE), booking is refused while it is open (`assertBookable`, SHORTAGE_OPEN), a person decides (`decideShortage`, `inventory.audit`, audited; the order flow carries it out), cards never close by themselves; acceptance test on PostgreSQL
  - GitHub pull request #31, 23 Oct
  - GitHub pull request #15 (commit `4563976`), 20 Oct 09:15 (Dhaka)
- **What it does (original scope):** Stock pull from the ERP at SKU / colour / size level

## PR 199

**Order push to the ERP as a document, never as journal lines**

**বাংলায়:** অর্ডার ERP-তে বিক্রির ডকুমেন্ট হিসেবে যায়, কখনো হিসাবের এন্ট্রি হিসেবে না।

**Details**

- **Status:** Merged · 2026-10-20
  - Build status row: order push as a business document (sales order: lines, customer, address, payment method), never journal lines — `assertNoJournal` refuses any document carrying debit/credit lines; transactional outbox (ErpPush written in the same transaction as the order change), relay with backoff and a dead state after `erp.push.maxAttempts` tries (backoff `erp.push.backoffBaseSeconds` to `backoffMaxSeconds`); status changes pushed as their own documents; no-ERP stores mark SKIPPED_NO_ERP (ERP-absent guard); `/api/admin/inventory/pushes`, `/pushes/retry` (`inventory.sync`)
  - GitHub pull request #17 (commit `1c8a4d6`), 20 Oct 11:17 (Dhaka)
- **What it does (original scope):** Order push to the ERP as a document, never as journal lines

## PR 200

**Idempotency on every ERP push — no duplicate stock movement is possible**

**বাংলায়:** একই অর্ডার দুবার ERP-তে গেলেও একবারই গোনা হয়।

**Details**

- **Status:** Merged · 2026-10-20
  - Build status row: idempotency on every ERP push: deterministic key from store, order, document type and a canonical hash of the body; the same change twice is one row and one ERP call, the ERP gets the key as its idempotency header (mock and live); a retried document never makes a second stock movement; DB tests for double enqueue, relay crash between send and mark, and retry after DEAD

Typed calls and answers of `docs/erp/site-changes-v6.md`: `GET /catalog/variants?styleCode=`, `shopPrice`, `grade`, `fromReturnStock`, `POST /orders` v6 fields and refusals, `POST /shipments`, `PUT /orders/{id}/delivery`, `PATCH /orders/{id}/lines/{lineId}`, `POST /return-lists`, `GET /returns` (+ `/summary`, `/claims`), `GET /exchanges`, `POST /exchanges/{id}/late-return`, `GET /account`, `PUT /daily-summaries/{date}`, `GET /daily-summaries`, `PUT /fixed-costs/{month}`, `GET /cost-of-goods`.
